description: Extracts shared Health Insurance Premium Payment (HIPP) application and correspondence fields across state programs using OCR, layout analysis, and source confidence. Match fields by meaning rather than state branding, exact headings, section numbers, or page positions. Household members are emitted as explicitly named scalar fields in their listed order.

fieldSchema.name: HippApplication
fieldSchema.description: Shared fields from state HIPP applications and correspondence forms. Recognize equivalent labels across layouts. Policyholder fields describe the insurance subscriber or employee; use applicant or head-of-household information only when the form identifies that person as the policyholder. Household ordinal fields describe the corresponding listed household member, including in unnumbered tables; do not assume household members exclude the policyholder. Preserve member order and do not duplicate policyholder information into an empty household entry. Extract only information supported by the document; leave absent or inapplicable fields unset rather than inventing values or treating missing checkboxes as false.

ApplicationId.description: The HIPP application identifier, usually printed near the form heading.

CorrespondenceType.description: The application or correspondence type indicated on the document, such as a new application, renewal, paystub submission, or information change. Preserve the document's wording; leave unset if no type is indicated.

HippNumber.description: The numeric HIPP program or case number, when present. Do not assume a fixed number of digits or substitute a Medicaid ID or insurance policy number.

PolicyholderDateOfBirth.description: Policyholder or employee date of birth.

Household1stPersonFirstName.description: First name from the 1st listed household member; use the policyholder's name only if that person is explicitly listed in this household entry.

Household1stPersonMiddleInitial.description: Middle initial from the 1st listed household member.

Household1stPersonLastName.description: Last name from the 1st listed household member.

Household1stPersonDateOfBirth.description: Date of birth from the 1st listed household member.

Household1stPersonRelationship.description: Selected relationship to the policyholder from the 1st listed household member.

Household1stPersonOtherRelationship.description: Other relationship text from the 1st listed household member, when Other is selected.

Household1stPersonGetsMedicaid.description: Whether the 1st listed household member gets Medicaid.

Household1stPersonMedicaidId.description: Medicaid ID from the 1st listed household member.

Household1stPersonGetsMedicare.description: Whether the 1st listed household member gets Medicare.

Household1stPersonCoveredByInsurance.description: Whether the 1st listed household member is covered under the policyholder's insurance.

Household1stPersonSocialSecurityNumber.description: Social Security Number from the 1st listed household member.
